# git-hygiene

> Validate Git branches, commit messages and pull request titles with shared configuration.

- [Website](https://githygiene.chitrankagnihotri.com/): Interactive sandbox and package overview.
- [Changelog](https://githygiene.chitrankagnihotri.com/changelog): Release history.
- [Documentation](https://github.com/chitranklabs/git-hygiene/tree/main/docs): Maintained guides and reference; separate Monoline Docs site.
- [Source](https://github.com/chitranklabs/git-hygiene): CLI, Core API and GitHub Action.
